data.name: Mythic Fascination
data.description: When you use the fascinate or suggestion bardic performance ability, non-mythic creatures take a -%1 penalty on their saving throws against it. If you expend one use of mythic power when you activate the performance, the penalty also applies to mythic creatures.|HalfMythicLevel
